Implementation file: src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts - JSDoc header explicitly implements this story and its requirements: - `@story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md` - `@req REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION` - `@req REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION` - `@req REQ-PATH-FORMAT` - `@req REQ-REQ-FORMAT` - `@req REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT` - `@req REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING` - `@req REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY` - Core parsing/validation logic: - `normalizeCommentLine(rawLine: string)` - Trims whitespace, strips leading `*`, and preserves `@story` / `@req` tags in JSDoc-style comments. - Directly supports **REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING** and handling of varied comment formatting. - `processCommentLine(...)` and `processComment(...)` - Detect `@story` / `@req` tags, start a pending annotation, and treat subsequent lines as continuation. - Collapses multi-line values via `collapseAnnotationValue` in validate functions. - Satisfies **REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT** and **REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION** (multi-line handling and syntax parsing). - `validateStoryAnnotation(...)` - Trims and validates the `@story` value; reports: - `missing` story path (no value) with `invalidStoryFormat` and a detailed message. - `invalid` path when it does not match `options.storyPattern`. - Uses `collapseAnnotationValue`, `options.storyPattern` and `getFixedStoryPath` to support pattern enforcement and safe suffix auto-fix. - Directly implements **REQ-PATH-FORMAT**, **REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION**, **REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION**, **REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING**, and **REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY**. - `validateReqAnnotation(...)` - Trims and validates the `@req` value against `options.reqPattern`. - Reports `missing` or `invalid` with `invalidReqFormat` and detailed messages. - Implements **REQ-REQ-FORMAT**, **REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION**, and **REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY**. - `processComment(...)` - Iterates all lines of each comment `(comment.value.split(/\r?\n/))`, normalizes each line, calls `processCommentLine`, then `finalizePendingAnnotation` once per comment. - Ensures annotations split across multiple lines are validated once, satisfying **REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT**. - Rule wiring and ESLint best practices: - `meta` section provides: - `type: "problem"`, `docs.description`, `messages` with `invalidStoryFormat` and `invalidReqFormat` using the shared pattern `"Invalid annotation format: {{details}}."`. - `schema: getRuleSchema()` for option validation, aligning with ESLint/JSON-schema best practices (**Quality Standards** acceptance criterion). - `fixable: "code"` scoped to safe path suffix normalization only. - `create(context)`: - Resolves options with `resolveOptions(context.options || [])` and obtains `optionErrors` via `getOptionErrors()`. - On `Program` node, reports any configuration errors with `invalidRuleConfiguration` and then: - `const comments = sourceCode.getAllComments() || []; comments.forEach(comment => processComment(context, comment, options));` - This shows integration at the program level with all comments, and that format validation is independent yet compatible with other rules that also work off comments, satisfying the **Integration** acceptance criterion.
Documentation & helper utilities: src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-utils.ts - File-level JSDoc references this story: - `@story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md` - `collapseAnnotationValue(value: string): string` - Replaces `\s+` with `""` to collapse internal whitespace for multi-line annotations. - Comment explicitly ties to **REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT** and **REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT**. - `getFixedStoryPath(original: string): string | null` - Only handles missing `.md` and `.story.md` suffixes. - Ignores any path containing `".."`, preventing traversal and unsafe fixes. - Aligns with **REQ-PATH-FORMAT** and error-handling/edge-case safety. - `buildStoryErrorMessage(kind, value, options)` and `buildReqErrorMessage(kind, value, options)` - Use examples (`STORY_EXAMPLE_PATH` and `getDefaultReqExample()`) to produce detailed, actionable messages including offending value and expected example. - Precisely implement **REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY** and the **User Experience** acceptance criterion for clear, specific error messages.
Options & format specification: src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-options.ts - Encapsulates default patterns and examples: - `getDefaultStoryPattern(): /^docs\/stories\/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-DEV-[\w-]+\.story\.md$/` - Enforces relative `docs/stories/...` path with `.story.md` extension. - Directly satisfies **REQ-PATH-FORMAT**. - `getDefaultReqPattern(): /^REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+$/` and `getDefaultReqExample(): "REQ-EXAMPLE"` - Enforce `REQ-*` identifiers of uppercase letters/numbers/dashes. - Satisfies **REQ-REQ-FORMAT**. - `resolveOptions(rawOptions)` - Normalizes nested/flat configuration, validates regex patterns via `resolvePattern`, and accumulates `optionErrors`. - Provides `ResolvedAnnotationOptions` with `storyPattern`, `storyExample`, `reqPattern`, `reqExample` used by validation functions. - Ensures robust error handling for misconfigured patterns (invalid regexes), fulfilling **REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING** and contributing to **Error Handling**. - `getRuleSchema()` - Returns JSON schema for ESLint rule options, aligning with the story’s guidance on schema-based configuration.
Plugin integration: src/index.ts - `RULE_NAMES` array includes: `"valid-annotation-format"`. - Dynamic rule loader imports `./rules/${name}` and exposes via `rules` export. - `TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES` maps: - `"traceability/valid-annotation-format": "warn"`, differentiating format issues (warnings) from missing annotations/references (errors). - `configs.recommended` and `configs.strict` include this rule, ensuring it runs alongside `require-story-annotation` and `require-branch-annotation`. - This provides concrete evidence for the **Integration** acceptance criterion.
